title: Gaming Focused Rizz chat
features:
Gaming Focused Rizz Chat is a Rayfield-based Roblox chat utility designed to enhance in-game social interaction while keeping the interface clean, organized, and user-friendly. This script provides multiple categorized chat lines that can be sent automatically through Roblox’s new TextChatService.
The script includes three main chat categories: Rizz Lines for smooth and playful interactions, Joke Lines for self-aware and humorous messages, and Ragebait Lines for competitive or provocative situations. Each line is displayed clearly as a button, allowing fast and easy selection without clutter or unnecessary visuals.
A built-in cooldown system is included to help reduce spam risk and encourage safer usage. The script also displays a clear notice regarding Roblox chat verification, as automatic chat will not function on unverified accounts.
In addition to chat features, the script contains a Gaming Focused UI information tab that introduces the project vision behind the interface. This project aims to create a more advanced, performance-oriented UI system for gamers by prioritizing structure, efficiency, and long-term usability rather than rushed or low-quality design.
This release is an early beta version and is still under development. Future updates may include better organization, additional features, and overall improvements as the project continues.
Loadstring supported.
Rayfield UI required.
